description: Read the assets contained by a Marketo Folder or Program. Pages internally using offset/maxReturn up to row_limit and exports the vendor records to a workspace TSV. A truncated result includes next_offset for continuation; poll check_marketo_job_status to retrieve the export.
embedding_description: Read the assets contained by a Marketo Folder or Program. Pages internally using offset/maxReturn up to row_limit and exports the vendor records to a workspace TSV. A truncated result includes next_offset for continuation; poll check_marketo_job_status to retrieve the export.

result_processor_customizations.action_label: Marketo: Get Asset Folder Content job dispatched
result_processor_customizations.result_description: Queued job_id and status. Poll check_marketo_job_status for a TSV handle, row_count, columns, truncated, per-page envelope metadata and next_offset when truncated.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Poll the job before reporting success. Report path and row_count. Truncated reads can continue from next_offset with identical filters.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Read the assets contained by a Marketo Folder or Program. Pages internally using offset/maxReturn up to row_limit and exports the vendor records to a workspace TSV. A truncated result includes next_offset for continuation; poll check_marketo_job_status to retrieve the export.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: marketo.invalid_params: correct vendor-shaped inputs. marketo.permission_denied: vendor RBAC or workspace access refused. marketo.auth_failed: credential rejected. marketo.validation_failed: vendor rejected the operation. A transport failure may follow a mutation.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Use the registered credential and vendor Read-Only Assets / Read-Write Assets permissions. Reads do not prove write access. Read back state before retrying an uncertain mutation; these endpoints offer no CAS/ETag.
